Travel Desk Visitor Flow

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal travel orderly from first contact to handover. This page sets the routine for a smooth desk flow, clear updates, and steady passenger support.

When a traveler arrives, greet them promptly and confirm the purpose of the visit. Keep the desk area clear so documents, carrier checks, and passenger notes can move in sequence without delay. If a traveler brings a companion animal such as Ellie, remain calm and direct the conversation toward the next practical step.

Review the booking file and check that the travel plan matches the animal, the destination, and the passenger details. If anything is incomplete, ask for the missing item in plain language and record the issue for follow-up. The aim is to prevent confusion later and to keep the passenger informed at each stage.

Coordinate with the relevant support teams when handling approval, check-in preparation, or arrival collection. Use concise notes and confirm handoff details before ending the interaction. If the traveler needs a wait area or extra guidance, point them to the correct place and keep the conversation efficient.

At pickup, verify that the right passenger is matched to the right companion animal and close the file only after the handover is complete. If there is a concern, escalate it at once to the senior coordinator and do not improvise. Clear records help the next shift continue without interruption.

For further help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly through the usual support channel.
